eth_r = crypto.query("coin == 'ETH'")["r"]
moyennes_eth = []
for i in range(1000):
    moyennes_eth.append(eth_r.sample(len(eth_r), replace=True, random_state=i).mean())

boot_eth = pd.Series(moyennes_eth)
bas_eth = boot_eth.quantile(0.025)
haut_eth = boot_eth.quantile(0.975)
